retainedGeometry: Exact original female head hair shell, crown and fringe. Its topology and UVs are retained and its head-only weights map to the new fixed HairAnchor.
newGeometry: New code-parametric closed tapered/lobed ponytail and fixed tie band with an independent auxiliary skeleton, authored for this project under CC0-1.0.
material: Original HAIR base/normal/emission textures and glTF material retained. Runtime compatibility expects actor-local clones of the original MToon HAIR and outline.
springImplementation: Installed @pixiv/three-vrm-springbone 3.5.5, MIT. Source asset provides configuration and API smoke evidence, without game motion acceptance.
